# Draft:Enzai (software)

----
Enzai is an artificial intelligence governance software company headquartered in Belfast, United Kingdom. The company develops software that enables organizations to inventory AI models and manage compliance with regulations such as the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act.
History
Enzai was founded in 2021 by Ryan Donnelly and Jack Carlisle. In September 2023, the company raised $4 million in a seed funding round led by Cavalry Ventures, with participation from Seedcamp and Techstars.
In May 2024, the company announced it had opened an office in New York to serve North American customers.
Operations
Enzai’s software platform includes an AI Model Inventory and a Policy Centre designed to align algorithmic systems with regulatory frameworks.
In 2023, the United Kingdom's Centre for Data Ethics and Innovation (CDEI) featured Enzai’s tools in its official portfolio of AI Assurance Techniques. The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) has also cataloged the company's "AI Governance Platform" and "EU AI Act Compliance Framework" as recognized tools for implementing trustworthy AI.
